title.es: Aquel de la semana en Illescas
title.en: The One With the Week in Illescas

description.es: Pasa una semana, durante la cual Marta y Fina han estado pasando tiempo juntas en Illescas con el pretexto del trabajo. Las dos charlan en la cama. Carmen le dice a Fina que Marta la ha estado tratando con frialdad y que no le da el reconocimiento que merece en el trabajo. Dice que quiere hablar con Marta sobre ello, pero Fina le aconseja que no lo haga. Carmen ignora el consejo de Fina y va a hablar con Marta y, cuando la acusa de favorecer a Fina, las dos discuten.
description.en: A week goes by, during which Marta and Fina have been spending time together in Illescas under the pretext of work. The two of them chat in bed. Carmen tells Fina that Marta has been treating her coldly and not giving her the recognition she deserves at work. She says she wants to talk to Marta about it, but Fina advises her against it. Carmen ignores Fina's advice and goes to speak with Marta, and when she accuses Marta of favoring Fina, the two of them argue.
